body:
Parent: #1726
Depends on: #2181, #1713, #2146, #2147, #2148, #2149, #2150, #2151, #1601

## 原子目标

使用#1713已拆分的identity/MFA/WebAuthn/session/admin ports与private projections，生成并独立验证canonical Passkey、TOTP/MFA、Recovery、Enrollment及admin step-up sessions，确保DB、credential、JWT/Cookie/storage、auth_time、strength、duration与proof完全同源。本issue只负责canonical-authenticated variants，不实现authorization-bypass、migration-legacy或旧路径删除。

## 必须交付

1. 每个canonical variant exact由#2181registry声明并绑定current run/source/profile/user/admin/session/device/credential/proof/temporal identities；unsupported产品variant不得fixture-only实现。
2. Passkey/enrollment通过#2147production-semantic WebAuthn ceremony，要求真实owned credential row、method、`webauthn_uv` strength、authenticated credential row ref与signature/challenge evidence；JWT不暴露credential ID。
3. TOTP/MFA通过#2146真实MFA profile/challenge completion事实，DB/session/JWT/storage `mfa=1`与strength/method一致；不能只改boolean/claim。
4. Recovery通过真实recovery key consume/state transition生成，method/strength不得伪装Passkey或复用credential row。
5. Admin step-up proof绑定admin/account、current session、action、token/proof ID、issued/expiry、consume-once与revision；不得只设`stepupverified=true`或JWT `admin_step_up=1`。
6. Session family/device/refresh facts由#2148生成；refresh保留original authentication context/auth_time/credential/MFA strength，不重建或携带已消费step-up。
7. Cookie/storage由#2151production issuers/serializers生成，browser_session与persistent_30d遵守current server idle/absolute policy、session/persistent cookie attributes与deadline一致。
8. Credential删除/暂停只影响绑定该credential的sessions，不误撤销同账号其他credential/session；结果通过真实service/session validation验证。
9. Full/read-only/partial admin permissions引用#2149production catalog，但canonical session不因permissions被误标更强auth truth。
10. Canonical receipt完整记录truth class/variant、DB session、credential/MFA/recovery/proof、JWT/Cookie/storage、auth_time/duration/refresh/permission refs与digests，不记录secret/token。
11. Independent verifier重验DB/credential/proof/claims/Cookie/storage/session service/expiry/consume-once与tamper；不能只看browser已登录。
12. Static governance禁止hand-signedJWT、direct stepup boolean、placeholder credential、legacy strength、hardcoded duration与canonical label override。

## 固定约束

- 不实现authorization-bypass/migration-legacy，归#2183。
- 不删除legacy/hand-signed/permission paths，归#2184。
- 不修改production authentication/session/proof policies。
- 不实现login product UI。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- passkey无valid credential；
- DB legacy strength but JWT webauthn_uv；
- TOTP disabled but mfa=1；
- recovery bound Passkey row；
- proof cross-session/action/replay/expired；
- refresh changes auth_time/strength or recreates step-up；
- browser_session persistent Expires；
- persistent cookie/server deadline mismatch；
- credential deletion revokes unrelated session；
- placeholder/direct insert/hand-signed JWT；
- browser login success with mismatched facts；
- receipt/claims/storage tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Canonical variants只由对应production-semantic completion paths产生。
- [ ] DB/credential/proof/JWT/Cookie/storage/auth_time/strength/duration完全一致。
- [ ] Step-up exact action/session/TTL/consume-once，refresh不重建proof。
- [ ] Credential lifecycle只影响正确sessions。
- [ ] 本PR不实现bypass/legacy或删除旧路径。

## 非目标

- 不定义truth class registry。
- 不实现authorization bypass/legacy migration fixtures。
- 不删除hand-signed/compat paths。
- 不测试认证UI。
title: feat(test-fixtures): 生成并验证 production-semantic canonical authentication sessions
